question: Who among the following Indian wrestlers won the Gold Medal in the 57 kg category at the Asian Wrestling Championship 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aman Sherawat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Aman Sherawat:-**

 
 
• He won Gold Medal in the 57 kg category at the Asian Wrestling Championship 2023.
 
• Aman Sherawat is an Indian wrestler who hails from Haryana and has been a consistent performer in the national and international arena.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Asian Wrestling Championship:-**

 
 
• It is a major wrestling championship organized by the Asian Wrestling Federation.
 
• The championship features wrestlers from different countries in Asia competing in different weight categories.
